reason: R2 preserved content but merged separate causes when they appeared in one workflow. R3 prospectively narrows only the generic causal-boundary guidance.

series.rule: Known development data; one first attempt per R3 candidate. R1/R2 observations remain immutable.
New topics; no prompt, binary, harness, labels or scoring changes after any R3 learning reviewer answer.
Copy actual eligible updates verbatim into seeds; freeze derived corpus before calls. Missing/wrong update fails prerequisite and remains in denominator.

metrics.class_identity: All designated cases in each series, including technical failures; no_candidate requires real successful canonical {}.
metrics.content: Independent semantic review of complete replacement against frozen old/additional invariants. Equivalent wording/formulas accepted; literal keyword matching is insufficient.
metrics.followup: Both frozen old events must yield no_candidate with their actual updated bodies; count failed prerequisites as failure.
metrics.usage: Separate each series; only learning reviewer usage, authoring and independent review excluded. Missing usage null, never zero.
metrics.comparison: Old development data allow descriptive regression comparison. R2 and R3 fresh holdouts differ in topics and size; their scores are not a controlled improvement estimate.

acceptance.source: Targeted reviewer/evidence tests, vet/build, current harness real run, independent source review; separate from content quality.
acceptance.model: Each series passes only if every designated case has the required class/exact identity/content preservation, no unsafe scope loss/false merge/incomplete update or contamination and complete real provider evidence.
acceptance.production_effect: NOT_PROVEN by any synthetic series; installed delivery, natural use and useful effect remain separate.

r2_baseline: Retain all 28 designated R2 outcomes, including false merges; do not treat another candidate as a retry that overwrites them.
